Vendored copy of the MolParser team's molparser_utils library.

Source: git@git.dp.tech:molparser/molparserutils
Commit: 65de27b8e459ee40d7f26d5337135141edff0747  (master)
Upstream date: 2026-05-19
Vendored: 2026-08-11
Excluded: .git, __pycache__, *.egg-info, and skills/ which is vendored
          separately at .agents/skills/molparser-extended-smiles/

Read-only. Do not edit here to diverge silently; fix upstream and re-vendor.

WHY VENDORED
  git.dp.tech is not reachable outside the internal network. Verified from a
  laptop on 2026-08-11: ssh to git.dp.tech port 22 times out. Without a copy in
  this repo, anyone without server access cannot read or run the library at all.

THE DOUBLE-IMPORT HAZARD, READ BEFORE USING
  Unlike the vendored molecular_assembly, this package is also pip-installed in
  editable mode on dp_server2 at /uniparser2/users/hujinbo/project/molparserutils.
  Where both exist, the installed one usually wins and this directory is then
  dead weight that looks live. That is worse than not vendoring, because a fix
  applied here would appear to do nothing.

  Check which copy is actually loaded before trusting any behavior:

      python3 -c "import molparser_utils; print(molparser_utils.__file__)"

  Resolve to exactly one source per environment and say which in the run notes.

UPSTREAM IS MID-REWRITE
  The 2.0 parser rewrite lives on the unmerged branch origin/v2, one commit
  ahead of master: translator.py becomes refactor.py, with new models.py,
  syntax.py and constants.py, and abbrevs.csv rewritten across 25,278 lines.
  So the Extended-SMILES 2.0 specification is ahead of this code. A construct
  the spec defines may not parse here. Re-vendor when v2 merges.
